transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining today's course-materials meeting. Before I finalize the reserve plan for the upcoming undergraduate course, I'd like to hear from each of you. We need to ensure the required reading packet is available to students before the course begins, and our draft currently lists 40 simultaneous digital users, 10 print copies, and scanned PDF files. I'd appreciate any input or concerns from the instructor, copyright librarian, accessibility coordinator, and bookstore manager before I make my final decision.
